name: ExitOnOppositeStrongTrendBar
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_lt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(open[0] - close[0], bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0])) && el_le(close[0] - low[0], tailFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_gt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(close[0] - open[0], bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0])) && el_le(high[0] - close[0], tailFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
